results.question: Show me my total spending per month in 2025 as a line chart.
results.sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
GROUP BY
  month
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 200

results.question: Chart my cumulative spending over 2025 as an area chart.
results.sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN booked_on <= T2.max_date THEN -amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
JOIN (
  SELECT
    MAX(booked_on) AS max_date
  FROM transaction_view
) AS T2
  ON 1 = 1
GROUP BY
  month
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 200

LIMIT 200

results.question: Compare how my spending added up over the first half of 2025 and over the second half.
results.sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS month_of_half,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) <= 6
    THEN 'Erstes Halbjahr'
    ELSE 'Zweites Halbjahr'
  END AS half,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
GROUP BY
  month_of_half,
  half
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  STRFTIME('%m', booked_on)
LIMIT 200

results.question: Vergleiche, wie sich meine Ausgaben im ersten und im zweiten Halbjahr 2025 aufsummiert haben.
results.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS TEXT) AS month_of_half,
  CASE
    WHEN STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) BETWEEN '01' AND '06'
    THEN 'first half'
    ELSE 'second half'
  END AS half,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  month_of_half,
  half
ORDER BY
  half DESC,
  month_of_half ASC
LIMIT 200
